concepts.name: Cylinder And Cone Volume
concepts.simple_definition: The volume of a cylinder is πr²h, and a cone of same base and height is 1/3 of that volume.
concepts.deep_explanation: This relationship shows that three cones of the same base area and height can fully fill one cylinder of matching dimensions.
concepts.real_example: A cylinder cup of radius 3 and height 10 has volume 90π. A matching cone has volume 30π.
concepts.common_confusion: Forgetting the 1/3 factor in the volume of a cone.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: የሲሊንደር ይዘት (Volume) πr²h ሲሆን፣ ተመሳሳይ መሠረትና ቁመት ያለው ኮን ደግሞ የሲሊንደሩን አንድ ሦስተኛ (1/3) ይይዛል።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ይህ የሚያሳየው ተመሳሳይ የመሠረት ስፋትና ቁመት ያላቸው ሦስት ኮኖች አንድን ሲሊንደር ሙሉ በሙሉ መሙላት እንደሚችሉ ነው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ራዲየሱ 3 እና ቁመቱ 10 የሆነ የሲሊንደር ኩባያ ይዘት 90π ሲሆን፣ ተመሳሳይ ኮን ደግሞ 30π ይዘት አለው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የኮን ይዘትን ሲያሰሉ 1/3 የሚለውን ማባዣ መርሳት።

concepts.name: Solid Figures 288 ✓ Lateral Surface ✓ Sl
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 6: Solid Figures 288 ✓ Lateral surface ✓ Slant height ✓ Prism ✓ Sphere ✓ Pyramid ✓ Total surface Area ✓ Frustum ✓ Regular pyramid ✓ Volume ✓ Cone ✓ Cross-section ✓ Cylinder INTRODUCTION Recall that solid figures are three-dimensional objects, meaning they have length, width and height
concepts.deep_explanation: Because they have three dimensions, they have depth and take up space in our universe
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Solid Figures 288 ✓ Lateral surface ✓ Sl from page 297.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Solid Figures 288 ✓ Lateral surface ✓ Sl with adjacent topics in Chapter 6.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 6: Solid Figures 288 ✓ Lateral surface ✓ Slant height ✓ Prism ✓ Sphere ✓ Pyramid ✓ Total surface Area ✓ Frustum ✓ Regular pyramid ✓ Volume ✓ Cone ✓ Cross-section ✓ Cylinder INTRODUCTION Recall that solid figures are three-dimensional objects, meaning they have length, width and height (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Because they have three dimensions, they have depth and take up space in our universe — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 297 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
